name: Original Looks for Reset to Original
description: Remembers each villager's original look -- the head, body and mask they had before any Change Appearance or island event changed them -- so Change Appearance and Change Appearance for All can put them back with Reset to original (the head look goes back to Auto too). Each villager's look is noted the first time the patcher sees them: when they are born or arrive, or, for a village you already have, the first time you play it with this patch; a look noted is never written over. For villagers changed before this patch, Repair Saves & Logs adds the original the patcher's logs prove -- the look before their earliest "Appearance changed" record -- and never guesses: when the logs cannot prove it, Change Appearance says the original look is not known. The looks are kept in the save's own Original Looks file, follow each villager (through deaths, reloads and renames) and are copied by Back Up Saves; Start Over clears them. **On by default.** **Requires the Origins-exclusive base, which the patcher installs automatically with it** (Change Appearance is there). **Works the same with every other patch and in every population mode.** **Not yet seen in a running game.** The companion is "VVFP Original Look.dll", started by VVFP Startup.dll; it changes nothing in the game itself. If it cannot be loaded, Change Appearance says the original look is not known.
behavior_changes: Each villager's head, body and mask (the mask the Origins companion keeps, its VvfpMaskOf) are noted the first time the companion sees them, in the save's own "Virtual Villagers Fun Patcher\Save <S>\Data\Original Looks\Original Looks - Save <S>.dat" (native/vvfp_original_look/original_look_store.inc), and never written over. The companion looks at the villager records from the game's own thread between frames (a WH_GETMESSAGE hook on that thread and a thread timer, at most every 250 ms): a villager present when a village is bound is a first-run original, one who appears after is a born / arrived one.

A village is bound only once its records have held still for 1.5 s; one whose file is missing or belongs to another village is kept in memory only until the game itself saves that slot again (so the title screen's seeded records are never written into a slot's file).

Repair Saves & Logs (game closed) adds the originals the logs prove (src/vv_original_look.py): the Old head and Old body of each villager's earliest "Appearance changed" record, the mask before it when logged; where a change is seen with no record, the original is marked not known.
Change Appearance's Reset to original reads it through VvfpOriginalLookGet (native/shared/original_look.h).
explicit_non_changes: This row changes no executable bytes and writes nothing into the game's memory: no splice, no record byte; the companion only reads the villager records and the slot field.
The save is never written; the Original Looks file is the patcher's own.
A corrupt Original Looks file is moved aside intact and never read or written over; another village's file is never replaced on what is on screen alone.
